headline: BootLoops manuscript reports 15 new Feynman-integral results among 30 computed integrals
summary: A preliminary author-hosted manuscript presents analytic forms or differential equations with boundary data and standalone evaluation code for 30 multi-loop Feynman integrals across polylogarithmic, elliptic, and K3/Calabi–Yau classes. The authors identify 15 as known results recomputed by the method and 15 as new at the kinematics stated in each entry. The claimed set includes results for exact-top-mass diboson processes and massive three-loop light-by-light integrals, but several are restricted to fixed mass ratios, kinematic slices or paths, and one W-pair result is evaluated on an unphysical line.
